name: Korean Gochujang Tofu
ingredients: 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp rice vinegar
2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp grated ginger
1 cup shredded cabbage kimchi-style salad, optional
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger and 3 tbsp water into a sauce.
Pan-sear the tofu slices in the oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Pour the sauce around the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes, spooning it over, until sticky.
Wilt the spinach in the pan for 1 minute.
Serve topped with spring onion, with rice on the side if desired.
note: Gochujang contains some sugar and salt, so keep the quantity to 1 tablespoon for two.
